requirement:
HC represents a GitHub issue by a stable owner, repository, and issue-number
identity. Reading the node supplies the issue's title, opening post, and
open/closed status as one snapshot. HC computes its fingerprint and formatted
text from that supplied snapshot through `Domain`.

For illustration:

```rust,ignore
struct GithubIssueContents {
    title: String,
    opening_post: String,
    status: IssueStatus,
}

enum IssueStatus {
    Open,
    Closed,
}
```
rationale: `requirements.sdk.habeas.github_nodes` has no {test} references and no tests. Searching the repository for `GithubIssueContents`, `IssueStatus` and `GithubIssue` found them only in the book's illustrative snippets in `md/requirements/sdk/habeas.md`, not in any source or test code. The requirement's obligations are therefore untested: a stable owner/repository/issue-number identity, one snapshot of title, opening post and status, and fingerprint and formatted text computed through `Domain`. The gap is acknowledged. `src/sdk.rs#enum[HabeasNode]` carries a {fixme} for exactly this requirement. Its body says GitHub issue graph nodes are deferred and that the identity and retained contents have no implementation or tests. It names nikomatsakis/habeas-codicem#26, which is open. The {fixme} still describes a real gap, because I found no tests or implementation for these obligations.
